_comment: Senior Spotlights — editor-curated senior profiles, shown on the dashboard's Spotlight tab. Cross-sport file: each entry may set `sport` (shown only on that sport's dashboard) or omit it (shown everywhere). Entries render newest-first; an entry disappears when `expires_at` passes (omit for evergreen). `photo_url` is optional — the school logo fills in. See docs/spotlights.md.
